name: Magefan Login As Customer
author: magefan

sections.description:
The Magefan Login as Customer plugin allows WordPress administrators to log in as any registered user or WooCommerce customer directly from the admin users or orders grid.

Key features:

  • Add a “Login” button to the Users grid for administrators.
  • Add a “Login” button to the WooCommerce Orders grid (optional if WooCommerce is installed).
  • Secure login with nonces to protect your site.
  • Fully compatible with WordPress and WooCommerce.

Usage

Once activated:

  1. Log in to your WordPress Admin Panel.
  2. Navigate to the Users grid or WooCommerce Orders grid.
  3. Click the “Login” button next to the desired user/customer.
  4. You will be logged in as that user and redirected to the frontend.

Note: Only administrators can see the “Login” button.
sections.faq:
Can I use this without WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin works on the Users grid even if WooCommerce is not installed. The Orders grid buttons only appear if WooCommerce is active.

Is this secure?

Yes! Each login uses a WordPress nonce for security, and only administrators can access the login buttons.
